No. 523-A/12/27/2026/RECRUITMENT-ADMN (Adv. No.03/2026) Date: 07-11-2026 
 
 
वॉक-इन इंटरʩू/WALK-IN-INTERVIEW 
 
RECRUITMENT OF VISITING FAUCLTY or ADJUNCT FACULTY TO THE 
POST OF PROFESSOR, DEPT. OF NEURO-SURGERY 
 
 
 
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for engagement of Visiting Faculty or 
Adjunct Faculty to the post of Professor in the following department on contractual basis through 
walk-in-interview at ESIC Super Speciality Hospital, Sanathnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana: 
  
Sl. No Department Post. Advt. Vacancies Date & Time of Interview 
1 Neuro-Surgery Professor  01 13-11-2026 @ 11 : 00 AM 
 
Note: 
Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease subject to the actual requirement for 
patient care and NMC requirement.  The Competent Authority reserves the right of any 
amendment, cancellation and changes to this advertisement as a whole or in part without 
assigning any reason or giving notice in the interest of patient care.  
 
Educational Qualifications,  Experience & Age Limit: 
 
S. 
No. 
Designation Required Education Qualification/Experience/Age 
1 Visiting Faculty or 
Adjunct Faculty 
(Professor) 
1. Should possess the Postgraduate degree as 
prescribed or a recognized qualification equivalent 
thereto in Neuro-Surgery. 
2. A minimum of 8 years of work experience in the 
Dept. of Neuro-Surgery after obtaining the 
postgraduate degree. 
3. Not exceeding 69 years on the date of Walk-in-
Interview 
  
 
 

 
Page 2 of 4 
 
Note: 
1. Preference in appointment shall be given to those who have served as Faculty in Medical 
Colleges/Medical Institutions or in Medical Institutions affiliated with the NBE or in Foreign 
Medical Teaching Institutions. 
 
2. The crucial date for determining the age limit, work experience and other criteria regarding 
eligibility for the post shall be the date of interview in the concerned department. 
 
Pay & Allowances: 
1. The Visiting Faculty/Adjunct Faculty (Professor) shall be entitled to an honorarium of 
₹6,000/- (Rupees Six Thousand only) per day. 
 
2. The Visiting Faculty/Adjunct Faculty (Professor) shall be entitled for reimbursement of 
travel expense would be as per extant TA Rules and it would be limited to actual 
expenditure incurred subject to production of proof of travel for a maximum of six 
outstation journey per year by shortest route. 
 
Scope of Work: 
  
1. Visiting/Adjunct Faculty will be assigned teaching responsibilities. He/she should conduct at 
least 4 sessions in a month, such as theory, small group discussions, practical’s, 
community based sessions or clinical/bed-side teaching sessions, etc., with each session of 
not less than 3 hours’ duration. 
 
2. He/she shall not be involved in the routine administrative work of the department and shall 
not replace the roles and responsibilities of the full-time faculty in the department. Six 
monthly feedback on teaching by the him/her will be obtained and assessed by this hospital. 
 
Terms of Contract: 
 
1) Selected candidate shall be appointed on purely contractual basis for a period of one year. 
The same can be extended by the Competent Authority of this hospital for another one year, 
based on the performance of the candidate and the feedback given by the students. 
2) The engagement shall not confer any right or preference for regular engagement. 
3) No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the walk-in-interview or joining. 
4) Hostel accommodation/quarters will not be provided. 
5) Candidate in the Government Service should submit “No Objection Certificate from the 
employer at the time of Interview”. 
6) Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification.  
7) The prescribed qualification is minimum and mere possessing the same does not entitle any 
candidate for selection. 
8) The selected candidate shall needs to execute a contract agreement on Rs.100/- Non-Judicial 
Bond Paper issued in his favor at the time of reporting for duty. 
9) The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. 
 
Page 3 of 4 
 
10) The decision of the competent authority regarding selection of candidates will be final and no 
representation will be entertained in this regard. 
11) The doctors at any time found guilty of any gross misconduct or negligence of his/her duties 
shall be terminated without any notice or payment in lieu of the notice period. 
12) In case, any information given or declaration by the candidate is found to be false or if the 
candidate has willfully suppressed any material information relevant to his/her appointment, 
he/she will be liable to be removed/terminated from the service and any action taken as 
deemed fit by the appointing authority. 
13) Appointment of selected candidates is subject to his/her being declared medically fit by 
competent Medical Board of the institute. 
14) In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection which may be detected at any 
stage even after the issue of appointment letter, the Institute reserves the right to 
modify/withdraw/cancel any communication made to the candidate.  
15) The Candidate intending to apply for multiple posts in same/other department shall submit 
separate applications. 
16) No claim for any service benefits like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical allowances, Medical 
benefits, Seniority, Promotion etc. will be admissible. 
17) Mere submission of application does not confer any right to the candidate to be eligible for 
interview unless they report on the scheduled date and time. 
18) Application should be submitted in the prescribed format only. The applications submitted in 
any other format or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. 
19) The candidates may ascertain their eligibility and report for interview on the scheduled date 
and time for interview. Candidates reporting after scheduled time will not be allowed to attend 
the interview process. 
20) ESIC reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage at its discretion and 
such decision will be binding on all concerned. Change in date of interview, etc. if any, will be 
intimated on website only. Candidates are advised to check the website 
www.esic.gov.in/recruitments regularly for any updated information relating to the 
recruitment. 
21) Wrong declarations/submission of false information or any other action contrary to law shall 
lead to cancellation of the candidature at any stage in addition to suitable legal action. 
22) Opportunity for appearing in the interview given to the candidates is purely on provisional. 
Joining of the candidates will be subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility conditions/production 
of prescribed certificates in case of reservation. 
 
Important Instructions: 
 
1. All the candidates are requested to appear for document verification along with filled 
application form as attached within the scheduled time. Only those candidates whose 
documents are verified will be allowed to attend Walk-in Interview. 
2. The Competent Authority have reserves the right to vary these vacancies including 
increase/decrease/cancellation of filling up of any or full without assigning any reason. 
3. Change in date of interview, etc, if any, will be intimated on website only. Candidates are 
advised to check the website regularly for any updated information relating to the 
recruitment. Other terms and conditions are as mentioned above. 
 
Page 4 of 4 
 
4. The research publications are not mandatory for retired/resigned/voluntarily retired from 
Government or other Medical Colleges in case of their re-engagement on the same 
designation. 
5. The post advertised can be upgraded/downgraded depending upon the vacancy/functional 
requirement. 
 
Selection Procedure: 
 
1) The selection will be made on the basis of performance of the candidate in the interview 
before the Selection Board. 
2) Result will be displayed on ESIC website (www.esic.gov.in/recruitments) only. 
3) Selected candidates will have to join immediately after receipt of the offer of appointment. 
 
HOW  TO APPLY: 
The eligible candidates along with their application filled properly in prescribed pro-forma    
(Annexure-IV) ear for walk-in-interview on the appointed dated & time.  
     
Documents required to be submitted at the time of interview: 
1. Two passport size Photographs. 
2. One sets of the following testimonials along with the originals for verification: 
a) Proof of age (10th Certificate/ Birth certificate) 
b) Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc) 
c) Address Proof (Ration Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc) 
d) SSLC /Matriculation Certificate or equivalent 
e) Educational Qualifications, Experience Certificate & Research Publications 
f) Valid certificate of registration with concerned Medical Council 
g) Reservation category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PH) 
h) No objection certificate from present employer (if applicable) 
i) Any other documents, if applicable/relevant 
 
VENUE OF INTERVIEW:  
Conference Hall, 2nd floor, ESIC Super Speciality Hospital, Sanathnagar, Hyderabad. 
 
REPORTING TIME FOR DOCUMENT VERIFICATION:  
One hour prior to Time of Interview. Candidates, whose documents are verified only, will be allowed 
to attend WALK-IN-INTERVIEW. 
 
 
 
 
 
           Sd/- 
           DEAN

Rolling Advertisement No. 09 of 2026         
Walk-in-interview for Recruitment of Teaching Faculty and Senior Residents 
on contract basis at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Indore (M.P.)
Retired/Working  Professor  may  also  apply  for  the  eligible  posts.  Any  Candidate  can  be 
appointed against any unfilled vacant reserved category post for 44 days with provision of  
possible extension, if required.
 
ESIC  Medical  College  &  Hospital,  Indore-452011  (MP) intends  to  fill  up  the  posts  of 
teaching faculty from eligible candidates for a period of 01 (One) year on contract basis extendable  
up  to  3  years  based  on  their satisfactory  performance  and  functional requirement  in  various 
disciplines as mentioned in this advertisement.
A  walk-in-interview  will  be  conducted  for  the  month  of  November-2026  on  the 
18/11/2026 (Reporting Time : 09:00 AM. No candidate will be allowed after  9:00AM)  and 
subsequently on 18  th   of every month. If the 18  th   happens to be a holiday, the interview will   
instead be held on the immediately following next date or as notified from time to time.  Notices 
regarding  such  vacancies  shall  be  published  only  on  the  ESIC  official  website.  No  separate 
advertisements will be issued in newspapers, will be made available exclusively on the official  
website: www.esic.gov.in/recruitments .
Monthly Recruitment Schedule (Rolling Advertisement)
Activity Timeline
Publication of vacancy details on the 
Institute website 1st to 7th of every month
Receipt of applications vide email Up to  15th of every month till  4:00PM only , for email.  No 
email will be accepted after that. 
Walk-in Interview 18th of every month (or the next working day if the 18 th is a 
holiday)
Candidates are advised to regularly visit the Institute website for monthly vacancy notifications,  
interview schedule and other updates.
Eligible candidates, who want to appear in the interview, must send scanned copy of  
Application  Form,  DD  along  with  required/supporting  documents  (including  research  paper 
publications and papers presented in conference, if any) to email: dean-indore.mp@esic.gov.in 
latest by 04.00 PM of 15 th of every month (or the next working day if the 15 th is a holiday).  
Candidates  must  write  their  Name,  Post  and  Department  on  the  subject  of  email.  All  the 
documents must be sent in one single complied PDF file through one single email only. 
 
Thereafter,  the  original  Application  Form  with  required/supporting  self-attested  
documents and original Demand Draft (as Interview Fee, if applicable) should also reach to  The 
Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Nanda Nagar, Indore (M.P) - 452011 on or before the  
date of Interview i.e. 17th of every month.

INSTRUCTIONS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION TO CANDIDATES
1. For  Teaching  Faculty  (Professor/Associate  Professor/Assistant  Professor)-  as  per  ESIC  
Headquarters Memorandum No.L-11/12/3/2016/MC-Faridabad/MEC dated.22.01.2018 and L-
11/12/3//2020/PG Basai/ME-CEL dated.28.10.2020:
a) Candidate  with  eligibility  for  a  higher  post(Professor/Associate  Professor)  would  be 
permitted to be interview against a lower post (Associate Professor/Assistant Professor)
b) In the event of selection of such candidate, the candidate would be considered for the  
placement  with  suitable  up  gradation  of  the  lower  post  as  per  eligibility;  and  
recommendation of the selection board.
c) The upgradation would be temporary and limited to the tenure of the teaching faculty/until 
the appointment of regular incumbent in the lower post.
2. In the event of no suitable/eligible candidate appeared for interview, candidate with eligibility  
for lower post i.e Assistant Professor/Associate Professor would be permitted to be interview  
against Associate Professor/Professor and in  the  event  of  selection of such  candidate, the 
candidate would be appointed in the lower post with suitable down gradation as per eligibility  
and recommendation of the selection board.
3. In case of no suitable/eligible candidate appeared for the interview of any advertised post, the  
Selection Board may relax the eligibility criteria (experience) and may allow the candidates  
who’s eligibility criteria is relaxed for interview for recruitment of such advertised posts. In  
event of selection of such candidate, the candidate would be considered for such post, as per  
the recommendation of the selection board.
4. These  vacancies  are  provisional  and  may  increase  or  decrease  as  per  the  actual 
requirement for the teaching & patient care. The Competent Authority reserves the right
